description: In front of you on the table are a small green basket, a yellow tray, a green block, two dice, a small toy figure, and a yellow banana on the right. The left hand reaches forward and to the right toward the banana, grasps it as a left-hand object, lifts it up and carries it leftward to the green basket, then lowers it into the basket and releases; the right hand stays near the front-right by the yellow die without touching anything.
